CustomField.description: Allows cutting the end of the original title when the title with the addition would exceed 255 characters.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When checked, the end of a long title is cut so the addition fits in 255 characters. When unchecked, the text is never cut: if the addition does not fit it is left out, and a tag for an old key is removed.
CustomField.label: User Story Title Allow Truncation
